registration.statement: An admitted proposition is a canonical distinguished form with a held orientation; denial is the retained complementary orientation, not a negative number. Conjunction retains joint proofs, disjunction retains a chosen generated branch and its alternatives, implication is a registered premise-to-conclusion transition, and a proof is a complete dependency trace of accepted rules. Consistency, soundness and completeness are machine-checkable only relative to the exact registered finite grammar and rule set.
